mapper.sql: id, chapter_id, title, file_type, file_url, file_size, duration, sort_order, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM courseware WHERE chapter_id = #{chapterId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT cw.id, cw.chapter_id, cw.title, cw.file_type, cw.file_url, cw.file_size, cw.duration, cw.sort_order, cw.created_at, cw.updated_at FROM courseware cw JOIN chapter ch ON cw.chapter_id = ch.id WHERE ch.course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO courseware (chapter_id, title, file_type, file_url, file_size, duration, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{chapterId}, #{title}, #{fileType}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileSize}, #{duration}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
